drawless.record.started: Recording frames as %1$s. Play as usual; stop with /drawless record stop. It stops by itself after %2$s minutes or when you leave the server.
drawless.record.stopping: Stopping the frame recording and saving the report.
drawless.record.running: Recording frames as %1$s: %2$s minutes, %3$s frames of 33 ms or longer so far.
drawless.record.idle: No frame recording is running and none has been saved in this session.
drawless.record.saved: Frame recording %1$s finished (%2$s): %3$s minutes measured, %4$s frames of 33 ms or longer. Saved: %5$s
drawless.record.failed: Could not save the frame recording: %1$s
drawless.benchmark.busy: A benchmark or probe is already running or saving. Wait, or use /drawless benchmark cancel.
drawless.benchmark.enter_world: Enter a world before starting a benchmark.
drawless.benchmark.invalid_label: Use a label of 1–24 Latin letters, digits, _ or -.
drawless.benchmark.unavailable: Cannot compare %s: another renderer manages or disables this feature.
drawless.benchmark.armed: Benchmark %s armed: %s bracketed ON run(s). Close chat and keep the camera still. Settings will be restored automatically.
drawless.benchmark.phase: DrawLess benchmark · %s · %s/%s · Keep the camera still
drawless.benchmark.finished: Benchmark complete. Settings restored. Review the report: %s
drawless.benchmark.partial: Partial benchmark saved; no aggregate result. Report: %s
drawless.benchmark.save_failed: Could not save the benchmark summary in %s. Settings were restored; check the log.
drawless.benchmark.reason.start_timeout: start conditions were not met within 60 seconds
drawless.benchmark.reason.screen_opened: a screen was opened or the game paused
drawless.benchmark.reason.environment_ch: window, video settings, resource packs or profiler changed
drawless.benchmark.reason.incomplete_pha: phase has too few samples or interrupted frames
drawless.benchmark.reason.save_failed: phase report could not be saved
drawless.player_profile.busy: Another measurement or report is active. Wait for it to finish before starting a new recording.
drawless.player_profile.armed: Player profile (%s) armed. Close chat: 2s warmup + 20s sampling. No optimization settings are changed.
drawless.player_profile.cancelled: Player profile cancelled. Any partial recording is saved separately.
drawless.player_profile.save_failed: Could not save player profile to %s. Check the log.
